title: Wso2am: unauthenticated attacker can inject arbitrary fake log lines into Apache ZooKeeper's operational log by…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary fake log lines into Apache ZooKeeper's operational log by sending a crafted add_auth("ensemble", ...) request. This vulnerability affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The issue has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
